question_text:
Complete the sentence.
All ___ have 4 right angles.
question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution_image_tag: This image shows a rectangle with 4 right angles indicated by the small squares at the corners.
solution: All rectangles have 4 right angles.

The other answer choices are not correct.
Trapezoids have exactly 1 pair of parallel sides. They do not need to have any right angles.
Rhombuses have 4 congruent sides. They do not need to have any right angles.
Parallelograms have 2 pairs of parallel sides. They do not need to have any right angles.
